{{Quote|We have an enclave not far from here. Peaceful, secluded&mdash;it's a place of study. Then the Killiks found us. Came crawling in the doors, the windows, the walls&hellip; the enclave was destroyed.|Alek Teral|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''House Teral ''' was the estate of [[House Teral]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]]. Located in the [[Alsakan Lowlands]], the estate was overrun by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], forcing some of the Terals to flee to the nearby [[Wardpost Duvaal]].
